title: Outpatient Management of Fever and Neutropenia in Adults Treated for Malignancy: ASCO and IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline Update
source: Taplitz RA et al. Journal of Clinical Oncology 2018; 36(14):1443-1453
description: Defines fever and neutropenia criteria, risk assessment and outpatient management pathways for adults treated for malignancy.

title: Platelet Transfusion for Patients With Cancer: ASCO Clinical Practice Guideline Update
source: Schiffer CA et al. Journal of Clinical Oncology 2018; 36(3):283-299
description: Covers platelet transfusion thresholds and prophylactic versus therapeutic transfusion in patients with cancer.

title: Management of Cancer-Associated Anemia With Erythropoiesis-Stimulating Agents: ASCO/ASH Clinical Practice Guideline Update
source: Bohlius J et al. Journal of Clinical Oncology 2019; 37(15):1336-1351 (co-published in Blood Advances 2019; 3(8):1197-1210)
description: Covers evaluation of cancer-associated anemia and the use of erythropoiesis-stimulating agents, transfusion and iron.

title: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Cancer-Related Fatigue
source: National Comprehensive Cancer Network (nccn.org), current version
description: Covers screening criteria and supportive care pathways for cancer-related fatigue.
